$comment: The hand-written part of the part contract, which scripts/docs/GenerateParts.ts merges into docs/generated/parts.json. descriptions: one line per part class, by component. roots: a component whose root is not env-<its name>. shared: anatomy several components render, by its class prefix. placed: a class that no prefix places, and its group. colors: the color properties of each component, public custom properties registered so they don’t inherit, with what each colors.

Accordion.env-accordion: The accordion: sections separated by full-width hairlines.
Accordion.env-accordion-content: The panel's content, in muted text lined up with the title.
Accordion.env-accordion-header: An item's heading, which holds its button.
Accordion.env-accordion-indicator: The plus that becomes a minus while the item is open.
Accordion.env-accordion-item: One section, with the hairline under it.
Accordion.env-accordion-panel: The panel that opens below the heading.
Accordion.env-accordion-trigger: The button that opens and closes the item.

Alert.env-alert: The alert: an icon and a message in its tone.
Alert.env-alert-action: The alert's action, such as a button.
Alert.env-alert-content: The column that holds the title and the message.
Alert.env-alert-dismiss: The button that dismisses the alert.
Alert.env-alert-icon: The icon of the alert's tone.

AnimatedNumber.env-animated-number: The number, which animates when its value changes.

Avatar.env-avatar: The avatar: an image, initials or a figure in a circle.
Avatar.env-avatar-check: The check at the bottom end of a chosen avatar.
Avatar.env-avatar-fallback: What shows without an image: initials or a figure.
Avatar.env-avatar-fallback-person: The fallback that shows a person's figure.
Avatar.env-avatar-person: The figure of a person, drawn when there are no initials.

AvatarButton.env-avatar-button: The button that shows an avatar.
AvatarButton.env-avatar-button-tooltip: The tooltip that names the account.

AvatarGroup.env-avatar-group-overflow: The count of avatars that don't fit.
AvatarGroup.env-avatar-group-tooltip: The tooltip that names an avatar or the hidden ones.

Badge.env-badge: The badge: a small pill label, or with data-count a compact count.
Badge.env-badge-count-label: What a count means, such as 12 unread, for assistive technology; visually hidden.
Badge.env-badge-label: The badge's text, or its count.

Bar.env-bar: The navigation bar: a nav landmark across the bottom of a compact window.
Bar.env-bar-list: The row of destinations, which share the bar's width.
Bar.env-bar-item: A destination: a link or button with its indicator above its label.
Bar.env-bar-indicator: The pill around a destination's icon, filled while the destination is current.
Bar.env-bar-label: A destination's label, under its indicator, cut short with an ellipsis.
Bar.env-bar-count: A destination's count, on the icon's top end; 999+ above 999.
Bar.env-bar-more: The last item past five destinations, which opens the rest in a menu.

Breadcrumbs.env-breadcrumbs-current: The current page, the last crumb.
Breadcrumbs.env-breadcrumbs-text: A crumb that is not a link.

Button.env-button-end: The quiet content at the button's end, such as a shortcut's keys.
Button.env-button-spinner: The spinner of a pending button.

ButtonGroup.env-button-group: The row or column of related buttons.

Calendar.env-calendar-day-mark: The mark under a day, such as today's.
Calendar.env-calendar-header: The row with the month and the previous and next buttons.
Calendar.env-calendar-next: The button for the next month.
Calendar.env-calendar-pad: An empty cell before the first day or after the last.
Calendar.env-calendar-previous: The button for the previous month.

CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap: The heatmap of days over months.
CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap-corner: The empty corner above the weekday labels.
CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap-day: One day's cell, filled by its level.
CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap-month: A month's label above the grid.
CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap-pad: An empty cell outside the range.
CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap-scroll: The region that scrolls the grid sideways.
CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap-swatch: One level's swatch in the legend.
CalendarHeatmap.env-calendar-heatmap-weekday: A weekday's label beside the grid.

Card.env-card-body: The card's content above the footer.
Card.env-card-header: The row with the title and the meta.
Card.env-card-meta: The short fact at the end of the title row.

Checkbox.env-checkbox-box: The box that shows the state.
Checkbox.env-checkbox-indicator: The check or dash inside the box.

CodeBlock.env-code-block-copy-status: The announcement that the code was copied.
CodeBlock.env-code-block-heading: The block's heading, such as a file name.

CodeDiff.env-code-diff: The diff of two versions of code.
CodeDiff.env-code-diff-failed: What the diff shows when it fails to load: the error, a sentence and Retry, announced as an alert.
CodeDiff.env-code-diff-failed-icon: The error icon of a diff that failed to load, in the danger color.

ColorPicker.env-color-picker-area: The square area of saturation and brightness over the hue.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-thumb: The thumb of the area or of a slider.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-controls: The row of the area and the sliders at its side.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-eye-dropper: The eyedropper, where the browser has one.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-sliders: The vertical hue and alpha sliders, side by side.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-values: The format, the eyedropper and copy, with the fields in equal columns under them.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-fields: The fields of the chosen format, or of one format's row.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-row: A format's row where several formats show together: its fields and its copy button.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-field: A channel's field with its letter, or the hex field.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-field-label: The letter of a channel's field, such as R.
ColorPicker.env-color-picker-popover: The popover of a ColorPickerButton, around its picker.

ColorPickerButton.env-color-picker-button: The button that shows the color and opens the picker.
ColorPickerButton.env-color-picker-button-value: The color's value on the button.

ColorSwatch.env-color-swatch: A swatch of one color, with its label and value.
ColorSwatch.env-color-swatch-value: The color's value in the format asked for.

Combobox.env-combobox-chip: A chosen value as a chip, in a multiple combobox.
Combobox.env-combobox-chip-remove: The button that removes a chip.
Combobox.env-combobox-clear: The button that clears the value.
Combobox.env-combobox-control: The well that holds the chips, the input and the buttons.
Combobox.env-combobox-empty: The message when no option matches.
Combobox.env-combobox-end: The buttons at the end of the well.
Combobox.env-combobox-item-indicator: The check of a chosen option.
Combobox.env-combobox-start: The icon at the start of the well, or of an option in the popup.
Combobox.env-combobox-status: The announcement of the number of options.
Combobox.env-combobox-trigger: The button that opens the list.
Combobox.env-combobox-value-icon: The chosen option's icon in the well.

CommandPalette.env-command-palette-empty-description: The empty state's quieter text under its title.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-empty-icon: The empty state's icon on its circle.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-footer: The footer with the keyboard hints.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-search: The search field, a ghost TextField around the search input.
CommandPalette.env-command-palette-status: The empty state in place of the list, and the announcement of the number of results.

Composer.env-composer-footer: The row of actions under the input.
Composer.env-composer-start: The actions at the start of the footer.
Composer.env-composer-surface: The surface around the input and the footer.

ConfirmButton.env-confirm-button: The button that asks to confirm before acting.
ConfirmButton.env-confirm-button-status: The announcement of the confirming state.

ConfirmDialog.env-confirm-dialog-form: The form that holds the dialog's fields and its confirming action.

ConnectedRows.env-connected-rows: Rows joined into one block, a small gap apart, with large outer and small inner corners.

CopyButton.env-copy-button: The button that copies a value.
CopyButton.env-copy-button-field: The field that shows the value beside the button.
CopyButton.env-copy-button-status: The announcement that the value was copied.

DatePicker.env-date-picker-actions: The row of actions under the calendar, the picker card's footer.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-actions-end: The actions at the end of that row.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-clear: The button that clears the date.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-end: The buttons at the end of the well.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-native: The native input that holds the value for forms.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-panes: The calendar and the times side by side.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-placeholder: The text shown without a date.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-popup: The picker card with the calendar, also on TimePicker and MonthPicker.
DatePicker.env-date-picker-trigger: The button that opens the calendar.

DescriptionList.env-description-list: The list of labels and values.

Dialog.env-dialog-actions: The row of actions at the bottom.
Dialog.env-dialog-backdrop: The backdrop behind a modal dialog.
Dialog.env-dialog-content: The dialog's content between the header and the actions.
Dialog.env-dialog-header: The row with the title and the close button.
Dialog.env-dialog-heading: The column with the title and the description.
Dialog.env-dialog-positioner: The positioner that centres the dialog.
Dialog.env-overlay-theme: The theme boundary of a dialog's, a sheet's or the command palette's portal. It has no box, so their scrim and positioner keep their own layers; the positioner is the env-window container.

DiffStat.env-diff-stat: The count of added and removed lines.

Disclosure.env-disclosure: The disclosure: a summary that shows and hides a panel.

DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-bar: The bar that holds the tabs.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-drag-image: The image that follows the pointer while a tab is dragged.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-end: The actions at the end of the bar.
DocumentTabs.env-document-tabs-item: One tab with its close button.

DropZone.env-drop-zone: The area that takes dropped files.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-description: The sentence about the accepted files.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-target: The target that takes the drop and opens the file picker.
DropZone.env-drop-zone-text: The column with the label and the description.

EditorChrome.env-editor-status: The editor's status line, such as a character count.
EditorChrome.env-editor-toolbar: The editor's formatting toolbar, a Toolbar of groups with a line between each, which scrolls sideways where it is wider than the editor.

Field.env-field: The field: label, control, description and error.

HoverCard.env-hover-card: The card that opens on hover.

HoverDetail.env-hover-detail: Text that shows more on hover or focus, a HoverCard's or Tooltip's text trigger, with a quiet dotted underline; an application's own text component can take it too.

IconButton.env-icon-button: The button that shows only an icon.

LineArt.env-line-art: The drawing: an SVG of hairlines that fills its container's box.

List.env-list-announcer: The announcements of a reordered item.
List.env-list-item-handle: The handle that reorders an item.
List.env-list-item-start: The start of an item, for the handle or a checkbox.

ListRow.env-list-row: The row anatomy of menu, select and combobox options.
ListRow.env-list-row-end: The end of a row, for a shortcut or a check.
ListRow.env-list-row-indicator: The check of a chosen row.
ListRow.env-list-row-text: The column with a row's label and description.

Listbox.env-listbox: A list of options in a popup.
Listbox.env-listbox-empty: The message when there are no options.

LoadingBar.env-loading-bar-contained: A loading bar inside a region rather than the frame.
LoadingBar.env-loading-bar-indicator: The moving part of the bar.

Markdown.env-markdown-source: The Markdown source shown as text.
Markdown.env-markdown-table: The region that scrolls a wide table.

Menu.env-menu-header: The header at the top of the menu.
Menu.env-menu-item-indicator-slot: The place for a chosen item's check.
Menu.env-menu-item-indicator: The check of a chosen item.
Menu.env-menu-item-end: The end of an item, for a shortcut or a chevron.
Menu.env-menu-item-text: The column with an item's label and description.
Menu.env-menu-submenu-chevron: The chevron of an item that opens a submenu.
Menu.env-menu-submenu-trigger: An item that opens a submenu.

Menubar.env-menubar-access-key: The underlined access key in a trigger's label.
Menubar.env-menubar-trigger: A button that opens a menu.

Message.env-message-header: The row with the author and the meta.
Message.env-message-meta: The time or another fact about the message.

Meter.env-meter-heading: The row with the label and the value.
Meter.env-meter-indicator: The filled part of the track.

MonthPicker.env-month-picker-header: The row with the year and the previous and next buttons.
MonthPicker.env-month-picker-month-mark: The mark under a month, such as the current one.
MonthPicker.env-month-picker-next: The button for the next year.
MonthPicker.env-month-picker-previous: The button for the previous year.

Drawer.env-drawer: The navigation drawer: a nav landmark, a column with the header, the list and the footer.
Drawer.env-drawer-header: Content above the destinations, such as the application's name or a search trigger.
Drawer.env-drawer-list: The list of destinations and groups, which scrolls where the drawer is shorter.
Drawer.env-drawer-section: A group: its heading and the list of its destinations.
Drawer.env-drawer-heading: A group's heading, which names the group's list.
Drawer.env-drawer-item: A destination: a link or button as wide as the drawer, with its icon, label and count.
Drawer.env-drawer-count: A destination's count, at the item's end; 999+ above 999.
Drawer.env-drawer-branch: A section: a destination with destinations nested under it, which open and close below it.
Drawer.env-drawer-branch-row: A section's row: the destination's link or button, with the section's button over its end.
Drawer.env-drawer-toggle: The button at the end of a section's link that opens and closes the section.
Drawer.env-drawer-chevron: A section's chevron, which points down, and up while the section is open.
Drawer.env-drawer-children: The list of a section's nested destinations, indented, hidden until found while closed.
Drawer.env-drawer-footer: Content below the destinations, at the bottom of the drawer.
Drawer.env-drawer-resize-handle: The handle on a resizable drawer's end edge, a separator that resizes it.

Page.env-page: The page: a readable width and the gutter; it never paints.
Page.env-page-content: The page's content at its width.

PageHeader.env-page-header-heading: The column with the title and the description.
PageHeader.env-page-header-row: The row with the title and the actions.
PageHeader.env-page-header-start: The content before the title, such as an avatar or a back button.
PageHeader.env-page-header-title-line: The line with the title and the meta.

Pager.env-pager-link-copy: The column with a link's label and title.
Pager.env-pager-link-label: A link's label, Previous or Next.
Pager.env-pager-link-next: The link to the next page.
Pager.env-pager-link-previous: The link to the previous page.
Pager.env-pager-link-title: The title of the page a link leads to.

Pagination.env-pagination-button: One page, previous or next button.

PanelDock.env-panel-dock-actions: A panel's actions in its header.
PanelDock.env-panel-dock-controls: A panel's window controls: minimize, maximize and close.
PanelDock.env-panel-dock-meta: A fact beside a panel's title.
PanelDock.env-panel-dock-probe: An invisible element that measures the dock's room.
PanelDock.env-panel-dock-resize-handle: The handle that resizes the dock.
PanelDock.env-panel-dock-strip: The strip of minimized panels' tabs.
PanelDock.env-panel-dock-tab-attention: The mark of a tab that asks for attention.
PanelDock.env-panel-dock-tab-restore: The button that restores a minimized panel.

Panes.env-panes: The panes: two panes side by side, or how they behave in less room; it never paints.
Panes.env-panes-main: The main pane of supporting panes.
Panes.env-panes-supporting: The supporting pane, a sheet over the main pane in less room.
Panes.env-panes-list: The list pane of list-detail panes.
Panes.env-panes-detail: The detail pane of list-detail panes.
Panes.env-panes-divider: The gap between the panes, with its grip, that resizes them.
Panes.env-panes-back: The button back to the list, when one pane shows at a time.
Panes.env-panes-close: The supporting sheet's close button, which shows only while the pane is a sheet.
Panes.env-panes-scrim: The scrim behind the supporting sheet.
Panes.env-panes-trigger: The button in the main pane that opens the supporting sheet, which hides while the panes sit side by side.

PickerPopup.env-picker-popup: The card DatePicker, TimePicker and MonthPicker open.
PickerPopup.env-picker-popup-body: The picker's content: a calendar, a time's wheels or a year of months.
PickerPopup.env-picker-popup-footer: The row of actions under the body.
PickerPopup.env-picker-popup-footer-end: The actions at the end of that row, such as Clear.

Popup.env-popup: The surface of menus, popovers, tooltips and lists.
Popup.env-popup-theme: The theme boundary around a popup.

Progress.env-progress-heading: The row with the label and the value.
Progress.env-progress-indicator: The filled part of the track.
Progress.env-progress-segment: One segment of a segmented bar.

Prose.env-prose: Long-form text: paragraphs, lists, headings and tables.

Rail.env-rail: The navigation rail: a nav landmark, a narrow column with the header, the list and the footer.
Rail.env-rail-header: Content above the destinations, such as a button that opens the drawer or the main action.
Rail.env-rail-list: The list of destinations, one under another, which scrolls where the rail is shorter.
Rail.env-rail-item: A destination: a link or button with its indicator above its label.
Rail.env-rail-indicator: The pill around a destination's icon, filled while the destination is current.
Rail.env-rail-label: A destination's short label, under its indicator.
Rail.env-rail-count: A destination's count, on the icon's top end; 999+ above 999.
Rail.env-rail-footer: Content at the bottom of the rail, such as the account's button.

Rating.env-rating-star-half: The filled half of a half star.

RelativeTime.env-relative-time: A time relative to now, with the exact time in a tooltip.

ResizeHandle.env-resize-handle: A handle that resizes a region.

RichText.env-rich-text-reference: A reference to a person or an item.
RichText.env-rich-text-suggestions: The list of suggestions while typing a reference.

RichTextEditor.env-rich-text-editor-control: The well around the toolbar and the document.

Scaffold.env-scaffold: The scaffold: the top bar, navigation and body regions; it never paints.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-skip-links: The skip links, shown on keyboard focus.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-skip-link: One link that skips to the body or the navigation.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-top-bar: The top bar region, the banner.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-navigation: The navigation region, which holds a slot per form.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-bar: The slot of the navigation bar, at the bottom of a compact window.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-rail: The slot of the navigation rail, at the start of a medium window.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-drawer: The slot of the navigation drawer, at the start from expanded.
Scaffold.env-scaffold-body: The body, the main region, which scrolls.

SegmentedControl.env-segmented-control: The segmented control: connected segments in one outline.
SegmentedControl.env-segmented-control-item-indicator: The check on the chosen segment, in place of its icon.

Select.env-select-item-indicator: The check of the chosen option.
Select.env-select-trigger: The button that shows the value and opens the list.

Sheet.env-sheet-body: The sheet's content, which scrolls between the heading and the actions.
Sheet.env-sheet-backdrop: The backdrop behind a modal sheet.
Sheet.env-sheet-viewport: The viewport the sheet slides in from, at its edge.
Sheet.env-sheet-resize-handle: The handle on a resizable side sheet's inner edge, a separator that resizes it.

Skeleton.env-skeleton-content: A skeleton's content: no box of its own, inert, inside the busy root.
Skeleton.env-skeleton-status: The visually hidden status beside a skeleton list, which says what is loading.

Slider.env-slider-control: The field: the track's tint, which takes the pointer.
Slider.env-slider-heading: The row of the label and the value, over the track.
Slider.env-slider-indicator: The fill from the start to the value.
Slider.env-slider-label: The label, inside at the start.
Slider.env-slider-thumb: The handle: a thin line at the value, under the pointer and on focus.
Slider.env-slider-track: The span the value moves along, inside the rounded ends, with the ticks.

Spinner.env-spinner: The spinner, or with data-show-label the status line that holds it and its label.
Spinner.env-spinner-label: The label shown beside the spinner, which says what is loading.

Surface.env-surface: A surface: fill, padding and corners.

Table.env-table-cell-label: A cell's column name, shown when rows stack.
Table.env-table-column-resize-handle: The handle that resizes a column.
Table.env-table-region: The region that scrolls the table.
Table.env-table-sort-button: The button that sorts by a column.

TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents: The navigation of the page's sections.
TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents-body: Around the list and the shape beside it.
TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents-item: One section, with the sections nested in it.
TableOfContents.env-table-of-contents-wave: The shape down the side of the list that marks the reader's place, widest beside it.

Tabs.env-tabs-tab: One tab: a text tab, the selected one with an indicator under it.

Text.env-text: Text in one of the type styles.

TextField.env-text-field-border: The border over the well's edge, which a floated label opens behind it.
TextField.env-text-field-control: The well around the input and its adornments.
TextField.env-text-field-end: The buttons at the end of the well.
TextField.env-text-field-start: The icon at the start of the well.

Textarea.env-textarea-resize-handle: The handle on the text area's bottom edge, which resizes it.

ThemeToggle.env-theme-toggle: The button that switches between light and dark.

TimeList.env-time-list: The columns of hours, minutes and periods.

Toast.env-toast-portal-theme: The theme boundary around the notifications.
Toast.env-toast-status-icon: The icon of a notification's tone.
Toast.env-toast-viewport: The region that holds the notifications.

Tooltip.env-tooltip-disabled-target: The wrapper that lets a disabled control show a tooltip.

TopBar.env-top-bar-start: The start of the bar, for a navigation button or a mark.
TopBar.env-top-bar-loading-bar: The page progress along the bar's bottom edge.

Tree.env-tree-chevron: The chevron that expands an item.
Tree.env-tree-end: The end of an item, for a count or actions.

Alert.--env-alert-icon: The tone's icon and the dismiss button, whose state layers it colors.

Avatar.--env-avatar-container: The fill behind the initials or figure, in place of the hue.

Badge.--env-badge-container: The fill, in place of the tone and variant.

Bar.--env-bar-item-container: The pill around the icon at rest; set, it takes state layers instead of the navigation's designed hover and press fills.
Bar.--env-bar-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.
Bar.--env-bar-item-icon: The icon of a destination that is not current.
Bar.--env-bar-item-selected: The pill around the icon of the current destination.
Bar.--env-bar-item-selected-content: The icon of the current destination.

Button.--env-button-container: The fill, in every variant; the state layers lie over it, and a solid variant takes them instead of its designed hover and press fills.
Button.--env-button-content: The label and icons, and the color of the state layers.
Button.--env-button-outline: The edge, where the variant draws one, such as outline.
Button.--env-button-selected: The fill of a pressed toggle, such as a toolbar button that is on.
Button.--env-button-selected-content: The icon and label of a pressed toggle.

Card.--env-card-container: The card's surface; an interactive card's state layers lie over it.
Card.--env-card-content: The text, and the color of an interactive card’s state layers.

Checkbox.--env-checkbox-selected: The box's fill while checked or indeterminate; set, it takes state layers instead of the designed hover and press fills.
Checkbox.--env-checkbox-icon: The check mark or dash, and the color of the state layers.

ColorPickerButton.--env-color-picker-button-container: The fill behind the swatch and the value, transparent by default.

Combobox.--env-combobox-chip-container: The fill of a chosen option’s chip.
Combobox.--env-combobox-chip-content: The chip's label and remove button.

Drawer.--env-drawer-item-container: The item at rest; set, it takes state layers instead of the navigation's designed hover and press fills.
Drawer.--env-drawer-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.
Drawer.--env-drawer-item-icon: The icon of a destination that is not current.
Drawer.--env-drawer-item-selected: The item of the current destination.
Drawer.--env-drawer-item-selected-content: The label and icon of the current destination.

IconButton.--env-button-container: The fill, in every variant; the state layers lie over it, and a solid variant takes them instead of its designed hover and press fills.
IconButton.--env-button-content: The label and icons, and the color of the state layers.
IconButton.--env-button-outline: The edge, where the variant draws one, such as outline.
IconButton.--env-button-selected: The fill of a pressed toggle, such as a toolbar button that is on.
IconButton.--env-button-selected-content: The icon and label of a pressed toggle.

List.--env-list-item-container: The row's fill; the state layers lie over it.
List.--env-list-item-content: The text, and the color of the state layers.
List.--env-list-item-selected: The fill of the current row and of a row whose checkbox is checked.
List.--env-list-item-selected-content: The text of a selected row.

Menu.--env-menu-item-container: The item's fill; the highlight and press are state layers over it.
Menu.--env-menu-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.

Radio.--env-radio-container: The row's fill in a vertical group; the state layers lie over it.
Radio.--env-radio-content: The label, and the color of a row's state layers.
Radio.--env-radio-selected: The dot and ring of the chosen option.

Rail.--env-rail-item-container: The pill around the icon at rest; set, it takes state layers instead of the navigation's designed hover and press fills.
Rail.--env-rail-item-content: The label, and the color of the state layers.
Rail.--env-rail-item-icon: The icon of a destination that is not current.
Rail.--env-rail-item-selected: The pill around the icon of the current destination.
Rail.--env-rail-item-selected-content: The icon of the current destination.

SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-container: The fill behind the options, transparent by default.
SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-outline: The outline around and between the segments.
SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-content: The labels of the options not chosen, and the color of their state layers.
SegmentedControl.--env-segmented-control-selected: The chosen option's fill; set, it takes state layers instead of the designed hover and press fills.

Select.--env-select-container: The trigger's fill; the state layers lie over it.
Select.--env-select-content: The trigger's label and chevron, and the color of the state layers.
Select.--env-select-outline: The trigger's edge, where its variant draws one.

Slider.--env-slider-indicator: The fill that shows the value.
Slider.--env-slider-content: The label, the value, the handle and the ticks.

Surface.--env-surface-container: The surface's fill, which its contents take as the color beneath them.

Switch.--env-switch-container: The track while off; the state layers lie over it.
Switch.--env-switch-content: The thumb while off, and the color of the state layers.
Switch.--env-switch-selected: The track while on; set, it takes state layers instead of the designed hover and press fills.

Tabs.--env-tabs-container: The rail behind the tabs, transparent by default.
Tabs.--env-tabs-content: The labels of the tabs not selected, and the color of their state layers.
Tabs.--env-tabs-indicator: The indicator under the selected tab.

TextField.--env-text-field-container: The well behind the entered text.
TextField.--env-text-field-indicator: The edge under the pointer, pressed and focused, the caret and the floating label while focused.

Textarea.--env-text-field-container: The well behind the entered text.
Textarea.--env-text-field-indicator: The edge under the pointer, pressed and focused, the caret and the floating label while focused.

Toast.--env-toast-container: The fill, in place of the tone; set, the dismiss button's states are state layers over it.
Toast.--env-toast-content: The message, icons and dismiss button, and the color of its state layers.

Tooltip.--env-tooltip-content: The text and the keys of a shortcut.
